ev_0004.summary: Figure is a closed trapezoid-like outline A-B-D-F-E-C. Vertices: A(67,45), B(446,45), C(162,140), D(351,140), E(162,329), F(351,329). Labels A, B, D, E, F are CV-bound and visually confirmed; the unlabeled point at (162,140) is labelled C in the image (C glyph visible left of the point). Segments: AB (horizontal top, CV seg_01), AC (left diagonal, CV seg_06, endpoints snapped to A and C from ~4-5 px overshoot), BD (right diagonal, CV seg_05, snapped to B and D), CE (left vertical, CV seg_02; top overshoot of 9 px above C is treated as the diagonal junction, bottom snapped to E), DF (right vertical, CV seg_03, same treatment), EF (bottom horizontal, CV seg_04, endpoints snapped to E and F). The diagonals are figure segments that terminate at C and D (not at a common intersection point), and terminate at the top line AB at A and B. No right-angle markers were reported, so none are submitted.
